name: ui-review help
description: Help mode entries for plugin:ui-review. Drafts (draft: true) were written from the code by framework/cli/help-coverage.mjs --draft; edit them into plain English and drop the draft flag.
author: AmberX AXF

entries.title: Reopen
entries.text: Puts a decided item back in the waiting list.

entries.title: Waiting
entries.text: Items still waiting for your decision.

entries.title: Screens list
entries.text: Shows or hides the list of screens beside the pictures.

entries.title: Previous screen
entries.text: The picture of the screen before this one.

entries.title: Next screen
entries.text: The picture of the next screen.

entries.title: Previous screen, every column
entries.text: Steps every column back one screen together, so phone and desktop stay lined up.

entries.title: Next screen, every column
entries.text: Steps every column on one screen together, so phone and desktop stay lined up.

entries.title: Re-capture
entries.text: Takes this screenshot again from the live app and replaces the picture that failed to load.

entries.title: Wait for my look approval before UI builds start
entries.text: On: a build that changes UI waits in UI Review until you approve its predicted look; Reject holds it. Off: it starts straight away.

entries.title: More
entries.text: Part of the predicted mockup: stands in for the screen's More menu. It does nothing here.

entries.title: Clear the selection
entries.text: Clears the selection. Part of UI Review.
